abilities.name: Mimic
abilities.description: Passive: 10% chance to echo an adjacent ally’s offensive ability after 500 ms at 80% power.

cast.description: A quick lute flourish announcing an echoed ally spell, bright plucked strings and soft magical doubling. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: An airy harmonic echo accent that layers over the copied offensive hit, soft golden chimes. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

charge.description: Brief delicate reverse lute resonance gathering for half a second before an ally ability is copied. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Reactive proc, not a manually aimed missile. Preview stages a successful proc; probability and copied ability are gameplay-owned.
Echo/resonance are musical overlays. Runtime must replay the original ally ability effect and sound; these overlays do not define the copied attack.

abilities.name: Dance
abilities.description: Perform eight rhythm inputs at 120 BPM; timing quality controls the offensive finale.

cast.description: A crisp single lute downbeat with a soft heel tap beginning a rhythmic combat dance. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: A joyful decisive lute strum and hand percussion finish, a magical musical burst without vocals. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

sustain.description: Seamless 120 BPM combat rhythm, two beats of woody lute plucks and light hand percussion, no melody quotation. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Preview illustrates one successful eight-beat performance, not automatic success.
No upgraded ally buff, extended sequence, or persistent damage aura. Actor sequence lasts 4200 ms including 200 ms recovery.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.description: Instantly remove debuffs from allies in a 4×4 area; a golden purification wave lasts 2 seconds.

cast.description: A pure brilliant lute chord releasing an instant cleansing harmony. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: Dark magical grit dissolves into clear golden crystalline chimes, gentle cleansing completion. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Base cleanse removes debuffs only: no healing or three-second immunity upgrades.
76×76 wave corresponds to the documented 4×4 area; target highlights are separate.

abilities.name: Helix
abilities.description: Toggle a three-tile support aura between blue-green regeneration and golden haste.

cast.description: A short rising lute bridge phrase signaling a change of support mode. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

impact.description: Soft healing chimes answer the chord, followed by a light brisk golden shimmer. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

sustain.description: Seamless tranquil lute overtone and watery blue-green harmonic pulse for a regeneration aura, restrained and gentle. Fantasy tactical game sound effect, isolated, no voice, no speech.

notes: Distinct regen and haste FX are selectable states, never simultaneous base bonuses.
38×38 aura is a local visual accent; gameplay owns the 3-tile range, 2-second toggle lockout, mana drain and up to 30-second uptime.
